"Create a mobile dark fantasy RPG inspired by anime dungeon hunter games.

The player starts as a weak Rank F hunter in a dangerous fantasy world.

GAMEPLAY:

- 3D fantasy environment.
- Third-person camera.
- Mobile touchscreen joystick and attack buttons.
- Real-time combat against monsters.
- Explore dungeons and defeat bosses.
- Collect weapons, armor and loot.
- Gain XP and level up.

RANK SYSTEM:
F, E, D, C, B, A, S, SS, SSS.

CHARACTER PROGRESSION:

- Strength
- Agility
- Vitality
- Intelligence
- Critical damage

Start with one playable character, one dungeon, three monster types and one boss.

Include a character status screen, health bar, XP bar, inventory and rank display.

Make the game playable on Android phones with responsive touchscreen controls.

Use a dark, realistic anime visual style with cinematic lighting. (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile dark-fantasy RPG about a Rank F hunter exploring a dungeon, fighting monsters, collecting loot, and leveling up.

## Requirements
- 3D environment with third-person camera and real-time combat.
- Responsive Android touchscreen joystick and attack controls.
- One playable character, one dungeon, three monster types, and one boss.
- Character status, health and XP bars, inventory, rank display, and progression attributes.
- Rank ladder: F, E, D, C, B, A, S, SS, SSS.
- Dark, realistic anime-inspired visual style with cinematic lighting.

## Decisions
- Built a browser-based Three.js game with keyboard/mouse alternatives alongside mobile touch controls.
- Assumed the player character is Kael Vareth and the dungeon is “The Sunken Sanctum.”

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a Three.js dungeon scene, hunter and enemy models, combat, boss encounter, loot drops, XP/leveling/rank progression, status and inventory screens, and responsive mobile HUD.
- `node --check game.js` passes.
- Opened the game in Playwright and saved/inspected `screenshots/latest.jpg`.

### Active
- Verify gameplay after starting the hunt and check runtime behavior beyond the initial screenshot.

### Blocked
- Browser emitted a 404 for `/favicon.ico`; no gameplay error was reported.

## Next Move
1. Inspect the current browser session and confirm that the game renders and plays correctly after starting.
2. Test mobile viewport controls and status/inventory interactions; address any discovered bugs.
3. Review `git status` and report final implementation and verification.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game interface and HUD.
- `style.css`: Dark fantasy styling and responsive mobile layouts.
- `game.js`: Three.js scene and gameplay systems.
- `screenshots/latest.jpg`: Most recent visual check.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Local preview was served at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Playwright showed one console error for missing `favicon.ico` and WebGL performance warnings.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile dark-fantasy RPG about a Rank F hunter exploring a dungeon, fighting monsters, collecting loot, and leveling up.

## Requirements
- 3D environment with third-person camera and real-time combat.
- Responsive Android touchscreen joystick and attack controls.
- One playable character, one dungeon, three monster types, and one boss.
- Status screen, health and XP bars, inventory, rank display, and progression attributes.
- Rank ladder: F, E, D, C, B, A, S, SS, SSS.
- Dark, realistic anime-inspired visual style with cinematic lighting.

## Decisions
- Built a browser-based Three.js game with keyboard and mouse controls alongside mobile touch controls.
- Assumed the player character is Kael Vareth and the dungeon is “The Sunken Sanctum.”

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the Three.js dungeon scene, hunter and enemy models, combat, boss encounter, loot, XP/leveling/rank progression, status and inventory screens, and responsive mobile HUD.
- Added a data-URI favicon in `index.html` to avoid the missing `/favicon.ico` request.
- `node --check game.js` passes.
- Verified the game starts, status and inventory navigation works, and mobile controls appear and fit a 390×844 viewport.

### Active
- Verify and tune gameplay: a brief movement-and-attack test defeated one guardian but left the player at 6 HP, so combat balance and continued play need checking.
- Reload and recheck the favicon fix and browser runtime.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue gameplay testing and adjust enemy damage/attack pacing if needed.
2. Reload the page and check for runtime errors and whether the favicon 404 is resolved.
3. Review `git status` and report implementation and verification; changes remain uncommitted.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game interface, HUD, and favicon.
- `style.css`: Dark-fantasy styling and responsive mobile layouts.
- `game.js`: Three.js scene and gameplay systems.
- `screenshots/latest.jpg`: Most recent saved visual check.

## Important Context
- Preview was served at `http://localhost:3002`.
- The browser reported an initial `/favicon.ico` 404 and WebGL performance warnings; the favicon change has not yet been verified after reload.
- Gameplay test result: HP `6 / 100`, XP `30 / 100 XP`, kills `1 / 6` after moving forward for about 4 seconds and making eight spaced attacks.
